source_title: Hibs fan views on 1-1 draw at St Mirren - BBC
source_excerpt:
We asked for your thoughts on the 1-1 draw at St Mirren that kept new Hibs boss Marink Reedijk waiting for his first win.
Kev: Hibs are getting better with every game under the new manager but it's clear some players are very low on confidence or just not good enough. We have nothing to fear against Hearts at Hampden but must take our chances.
John: Absolutely dire. This team have no idea how to win games. Play is so slow, allowing teams to defend in depth. Unless drastic changes happen the Championship beckons. Will give the coach until Christmas.
Marcus: I really feel for Reedijk, there are clearly players not good enough for our club that have to play because of a poorly assembled squad. That said, the run we are on is relegation fodder but I have faith that we can sort things out before it's too late. We must persevere.
John: One shot on target says it all. With no leader in the backline we lose yet another hapless goal with too many bodies inside the six-yard box getting in each other's way.
Lee: This is more and more looking like a recruitment issue. Changes from the bench rarely hold a positive outcome and when you look at all teams outside of the top three, they simply look like squads that Hibs will struggle to outperform. Fans feel let down by the club with the added reality of also letting down club legend David Gray.
Gordon: Simply awful once again. Glad of the point that stops the unacceptable run of defeats but there is simply nothing there. As for Jason Kerr, Grant Hanley for all his faults simply must start on Sunday. It's a game I and I suspect many Hibs fans are not looking forward to, a potential record defeat in the offing, not a single current Hibs player would get near the Hearts side.
